# NeuromorphicSensorFusion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A DARPA-strategic approach integrating neuromorphic computing principles into sensor systems for real-time, low-power signal processing and fusion. Enables in-network neuromorphic edge processing of multi-modal sensor data, critical for low-latency, energy-efficient perception in iNEST architectures.
